metadata:transcript.transcript: What kind of business could we come up with?
Well, I'd love to hear first.
So let me just ask you, do you have in your creative mind right now, like any ideas for a business that you would like to start?
So I'm into like women's empowerment and Mother Earth and children, like children's well-being.
And I think that really women are like the key to the earth.
I'm trained and experienced in movement, so like dance, fitness, yoga.
Yeah, and I've coached fitness before, and I've taught yoga for many years.
And I really, although I really like kind of like these yoga blends that incorporate kind of like some fitness things, I really love like restorative yoga.
And it, so, several months ago, I got this idea of starting a women's center.
I imagined it being a gym, so like a women's only gym.
And I want to call it Womb Women's Center.
And I wanted to have a childcare, little daycare so that women can come, you know, for whatever time they're at the center and their children can be like there, taken care of.
And there's also a saltwater pool and a saltwater jacuzzi because the idea that...

came to me was that, like, I was at my uncle's, and he has, like, this gorgeous, like, backyard space that he created, and there's this saltwater jacuzzi, and I was in there with my son, and being there in the jacuzzi, it was, like, I felt so relaxed and, like, so blissful, and the quality of the connection with my son was, like...

And so I realized, like, women need, like, if women can just have a regular way to, like, connect back to that really deep, like, relaxation, like, like you're saying, like, that's just what we emanate.
Like, that's how we then are in the world.
So I really, you know... We'll keep going on that.
